By order from Thy throne.
Amen.

title: I Surrender All
artist: Judson Van De Venter, Winfield S. Weeden

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
I surrender all,
I surrender all.
All to Thee my blessed Savior,
I surrender all.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
All to Jesus I surrender,
All to Him I freely give;
I will ever love and trust Him,
In His presence daily live.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
All to Jesus I surrender,
Humbly at His feet I bow,
Worldly pleasures all forsaken,
Take me Jesus take me now.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
All to Jesus I surrender,
Make me Savior wholly Thine;
Let me feel the Holy Spirit,
Truly know that Thou art mine.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
All to Jesus I surrender,
Lord I give myself to Thee.
Fill me with Thy love and power;
Let Thy blessings fall on me.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
All to Jesus I surrender,
Now I feel the sacred flame.
Oh the joy of full salvation!
Glory, glory to His name!

title: I Was There When It Happened

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
I was there when it happened,
And I ought to know,
His Spirit burning in me,
Set my heart aglow,
So I praise the Lord today.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
You ask me how I know that Jesus saves me,
How I know that all my sins are white as snow.
You ask me how I know that He forgave me,
Now listen I must tell you how I know.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
You ask me how I know that He redeemed me,
And how I received the peace no gold can buy.
How from the guilt and pow'r of sin He saved me,
Made me an heir to mansions in the sky.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
And now as thru the world I go rejoicing,
I am telling what a Savior dwells within.
How I plunged into the cleansing crimson fountain,
And Jesus washed my soul from ev'ry sin.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
I will praise Him, I will praise Him,
Praise the Lamb for sinners slain.
Give Him glory all ye people,
For His blood can wash away each stain.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
When I saw the cleansing fountain
Open wide for all my sin,
I obeyed the Spirit's wooing
When He said "Wilt thou be clean?"

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Tho' the way seemed straight and narrow,
All I claimed was swept away;
My ambitions, plans and wishes
At my feet in ashes lay.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Then God's fire upon the altar
Of my heart was set aflame.
I shall never cease to praise Him.
Glory, glory to His name!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Blessed be the name of Jesus!
I'm so glad He took me in.
He's forgiven my transgressions;
He has cleansed my heart from sin.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Glory, glory to the Father!
Glory, glory to the Son!
Glory, glory to the Spirit!
Glory to the Three in One!

title: I Will Sing Of My Redeemer

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Sing, oh sing, of my Redeemer.
With His blood He purchased me.
On the cross He sealed my pardon,
Paid the debt and made me free.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I will sing of my Redeemer,
And His wondrous love to me.
On the cruel cross He suffered,
From the curse to set me free.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
I will tell the wondrous story,
How my lost estate to save,
In His boundless love and mercy
He the ransom freely gave.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
I will praise my dear Redeemer;
His triumphant power I'll tell,
How the victory He giveth
Over sin and death and hell.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
I will sing of my Redeemer
And His heavenly love to me;
He from death to life hath brought me,
Son of God, with Him to be.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Be like Jesus, this my song,
In the home and in the throng;
Be like Jesus, all day long!
I would be like Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
He has broken ev'ry fetter,
I would be like Jesus;
That my soul may serve Him better,
I would be like Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
All the way from earth to glory,
I would be like Jesus;
Telling o'er and o'er the story,
I would be like Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
That in heaven He may meet me,
I would be like Jesus;
That His words "Well done," may greet me,
I would be like Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Immortal, invisible, God only wise,
In light inaccessible
Hid from our eyes;
Most blessed, most glorious,
The Ancient of Days;
Almighty, victorious,
Thy great name we praise.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Unresting, unhasting
And silent as light;
Nor wanting, nor wasting,
Thou rulest in might.
Thy justice, like mountains,
High soaring above;
Thy clouds, which are fountains
Of goodness and love.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
To all, life Thou givest,
To both great and small;
In all, life Thou livest,
The true life of all;
We blossom and flourish
As leaves on the tree,
And wither and perish
But naught changeth Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Great Father of glory,
Pure Father of light;
Thine angels adore Thee
All veiling their sight.
All praise we would render,
O help us to see
'Tis only the splendor
Of light hideth Thee.
Amen.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
In heavenly love abiding,
No change my heart shall fear;
And safe is such confiding,
For nothing changes here:
The storm may roar without me,
My heart may low be laid;
But God is round about me,
And can I be dismayed?

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Wherever He may guide me,
No want shall turn me back;
My Shepherd is beside me,
And nothing can I lack:
His wisdom ever waketh,
His sight is never dim;
He knows the way He taketh,
And I will walk with Him.

sections.label: Verse 3

title: In The Cross Of Christ I Glory

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
In the cross of Christ I glory,
Tow'ring o'er the wrecks of time;
All the light of sacred story
Gathers round its head sublime.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
When the woes of life o'ertake me,
Hopes deceive and fears annoy;
Never shall the cross forsake me,
Lo! it glows with peace and joy.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
When the sun of bliss is beaming
Light and love upon my way;
From the cross the radiance streaming
Adds more luster to the day.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Bane and blessing, pain and pleasure,
By the cross are sanctified;
Peace is there that knows no measure,
Joys that thro' all time abide.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
And He walks with me,
And He talks with me,
And He tells me I am His own;
And the joy we share as we tarry there,
None other has ever known.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I come to the garden alone,
While the dew is still on the roses;
And the voice I hear, falling on my ear,
The Son of God discloses.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
He speaks, and the sound of
His voice is so sweet,
The birds hush their singing,
And the melody that He gave to me,
Within my heart is ringing.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
I'd stay in the garden with Him,
Though the night around me be falling,
But He bids me go;
Through the voice of woe,
His voice to me is calling.

title: In The Sweet By And By

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
In the sweet by and by,
In the sweet by and by,
I'll have a mansion so bright and fair,
Won't it be glorious when I get there,
In the sweet by and by,
In the sweet by and by,
When the battle is done,
And the vict'ry is won,
In the sweet by and by.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
In the sweet by and by,
In the sweet by and by,
I'll stand at last on the street of pure gold,
Wonders and glory of heav'n behold,
In the sweet by and by,
In the sweet by and by,
Joy will be so complete when my Savior I meet,
In the sweet by and by.

title: Infant Holy Infant Lowly
artist: A.E. Rusbridge, Edith Margaret Gellibrand Reed

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Infant holy, infant lowly,
For His bed a cattle stall;
Oxen lowing, little knowing,
Christ the babe is Lord of all.
Swift are winging, angels singing,
Noels ringing, tidings bringing:
Christ the Babe is Lord of all.
Christ the Babe is Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Flocks were sleeping,
Shepherds keeping vigil
Till the morning new;
Saw the glory, heard the story,
Tidings of a gospel true.
Thus rejoicing, free from sorrow,
Praises voicing, greet the morrow:
Christ the Babe was born for you.
Christ the Babe was born for you.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
In a manger He is lying,
Who will greet Him as He sleeps?
Baby Jesus, infant Christ child,
Who will greet Him as He sleeps?
Angels winging, praises singing,
Noels ringing, tidings bringing:
Christ the Babe is Lord of all.
Christ the Babe is Lord of all.

title: It Came Upon A Midnight Clear
artist: Edmund H. Sears, Richard S. Willis

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
It came upon the midnight clear,
That glorious song of old;
From angels bending near the earth
To touch their harps of gold.
"Peace on the earth good will to men,
From heaven's all gracious King!"
The world in solemn stillness lay
To hear the angels sing.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Still thro' the cloven skies they come,
With peaceful wings unfurled;
And still their heavenly music floats,
O'er all the weary world.
Above its sad and lowly plains,
They bend on hovering wing;
And ever o'er its Babel sounds
The blessed angels sing.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
And ye, beneath life's crushing load,
Whose forms are bending low;
Who toil along the climbing way
With painful steps and slow.
Look now! for glad and golden hours,
Come swiftly on the wing;
O rest beside the weary road,
And hear the angels sing.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
For lo, the days are hastening on,
By prophet bards foretold;
When with the ever circling years,
Comes round the age of gold.
When peace shall over all the earth,
Its ancient splendors fling;
And the whole world give back the song
Which now the angels sing.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Yet with the woes of sin and strife
The world has suffered long;
Beneath the angel strain have rolled,
Two thousand years of wrong.
And man, at war with man, hears not,
The love song which they bring;
O hush the noise, ye men of strife,
And hear the angels sing.

title: It Is Glory Just To Walk With Him
artist: Avis Marguerite Burgeson Christiansen, Haldor Lillenas

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
It is glory, just to walk with Him.
It is glory, just to walk with Him.
He will guide my steps aright,
Thro' the vale and o'er the height.
It is glory, just to walk with Him.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
It is glory, just to walk with Him,
Whose blood has ransomed me.
It is rapture for my soul each day,
It is joy divine to feel,
To feel Him near.
Where'er my path may be,
Bless the Lord,
It's glory all the way.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
It is glory when the shadows fall,
To know that He is near.
Oh what joy to simply trust and pray,
It is glory to abide in Him.
When skies above are clear,
Yes, with Him it's glory all the way.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
'Twill be glory when I walk,
With Him on heaven's golden shore.
Never from His side again to stray,
'Twill be glory, wondrous glory,
With the Savior evermore,
Everlasting glory all the way.

title: It Is Well With My Soul
artist: Horatio G. Spafford, Philip Paul Bliss

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
It is well, with my soul,
It is well,
It is well, with my soul.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
When peace like a river,
Attendeth my way,
When sorrows,
Like sea billows roll;
Whatever my lot,
Thou hast taught me to say,
"It is well,
It is well, with my soul."

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Though Satan should buffet,
Tho' trials should come,
Let this blest assurance control;
That Christ has regarded
My helpless estate,
And hath shed His own blood
For my soul.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
My sin, O the bliss
Of this glorious tho't,
My sin not in part
But the whole
Is nailed to the cross
And I bear it no more.
Praise the Lord,
Praise the Lord, O my soul!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
O, Lord haste the day
When my faith shall be sight,
The clouds be rolled back
As a scroll;
The trump shall resound
And the Lord shall descend,
"Even so" it is well
With my soul.

title: Jesus I Come
artist: George C. Stebbins, William T. Sleeper

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Out of my bondage, sorrow and night,
Jesus, I come; Jesus I come.
Into Thy freedom, gladness and light,
Jesus, I come to Thee.
Out of my sickness into Thy health,
Out of my want and into Thy wealth.
Out of my sin and into thyself,
Jesus, I come to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Out of my shameful failure and loss,
Jesus, I come; Jesus, I come.
Into the glorious gain of Thy cross,
Jesus, I come to Thee.
Out of earth's sorrows into Thy balm,
Out of life's storms and into Thy calm.
Out of distress to jubilant psalm,
Jesus, I come to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Out of unrest and arrogant pride,
Jesus, I come; Jesus, I come.
Into Thy blessed will to abide,
Jesus, I come to Thee.
Out of myself to dwell in Thy love,
Out of despair into raptures above,
Upward for aye on wings like a dove,
Jesus, I come to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Out of the fear and dread of the tomb,
Jesus, I come; Jesus I come.
Into the joy and light of Thy home,
Jesus, I come to Thee.
Out of the depths of ruin untold,
Into the peace of Thy sheltering fold.
Ever Thy glorious face to behold,
Jesus, I come to Thee.

title: Jesus Is Tenderly Calling
artist: Fanny J. Crosby, George C. Stebbins

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Calling today, calling today,
Jesus is calling,
Is tenderly calling today.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Jesus is tenderly calling thee home
Calling today, calling today.
Why from the sunshine
Of love wilt thou roam
Farther and farther away?

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Jesus is calling the weary to rest
Calling today, calling today.
Bring Him your burden
And you shall be blest;
He will not turn you away.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Jesus is waiting; O come to Him now
Waiting today waiting today.
Come with your sins; at His feet lowly bow,
Come and no longer delay.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Jesus is pleading; O list to His voice
Hear Him today, hear Him today.
They who believe on His name shall rejoice.
Quickly arise and away.

title: Jesus Is The Sweetest Name I Know

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Jesus is the sweetest name I know,
And He's just the same as His lovely name,
And that's the reason why I love Him so;
Oh, Jesus is the sweetest name I know.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
There have been names that I have loved to hear,
But never has there been a name so dear
To this heart of mine as the name divine,
The precious, precious name of Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
There is no name in earth or heav'n above,
That we should give such honor and such love,
As the blessed name; let us all acclaim;
That wondrous, glorious name of Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
And some day I shall see Him face to face,
To thank and praise Him for His wondrous grace,
Which He gave to me when He made me free;
The blessed Son of God called Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Jesus, lover of my soul,
Let me to Thy bosom fly,
While the billows near me roll,
While the tempest still is high;
Hide me, O my Saviour, hide!
Till the storm of life is past;
Safe into the haven guide,
O receive my soul at last!

sections.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Thou, O Christ, art all I want,
More than all in Thee I find;
Raise the fallen, cheer the faint,
Heal the sick, and lead the blind.
Just and holy is Thy name,
I am all unrighteousness;
Vile and full of sin I am,
Thou art full of truth and grace.

sections.label: Verse 4
Chorus
sections.lyrics:
I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves me.
I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves even me.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I am so glad that our Father in heaven
Tells of His love in the book He has giv'n.
Wonderful things in the Bible I see.
This is the dearest that Jesus loves me.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Tho' I forget Him and wander away,
Still He doth love me wherever I stray.
Back to His dear loving arms would I flee
When I remember that Jesus loves me.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Oh, if there's only one song I can sing,
When in His beauty I see the great King,
This shall my song in eternity be.
Oh what a wonder that Jesus love me.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Jesus loves the little children,
All the children of the world.
Red and yellow, black and white,
They are precious in His sight--
Jesus loves the little children of the world.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Jesus died for all the children,
All the children of the world.
Red and yellow, black and white,
All are precious in His sight--
Jesus died for all the children of the world.

title: Jesus Paid It All
artist: Elvina M. Hall, John T. Grape

sections.label: Chorus
Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I hear the Savior say,
"Thy strength indeed is small;
Child of weakness watch and pray,
Find in Me thine all in all."

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Lord, now indeed I find,
Thy power and Thine alone;
Can change the leper's spots
And melt the heart of stone.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
For nothing good have I,
Whereby Thy grace to claim;
I'll wash my garments white,
In the blood of Calvary's Lamb.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
And when before the throne,
I stand in Him complete;
"Jesus died my soul to save,"
My lips shall still repeat.

title: Jesus The Very Thought Of Thee
artist: Bernard of Clairvaux, Edward Caswall, John B. Dykes

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Jesus, the very thought of Thee,
With sweetness fills my breast;
But sweeter far Thy face to see,
And in Thy presence rest.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
No voice can sing, no heart can frame,
Nor can the memory find
A sweeter sound than Thy blest name;
O Savior of mankind!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
O Hope of every contrite heart,
O Joy of all the meek;
To those who fall, how kind Thou art!
How good to those who seek!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
But what to those who find?
Ah, this no tongue or pen can show;
The love of Jesus, what it is
None but His loved ones know.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Jesu, our only joy be Thou,
As Thou our prize wilt be;
Jesus, be Thou our Glory now,
And thru eternity.
Amen.

sections.label: Chorus 1
sections.lyrics:
Jingle bells, jingle bells,
Jingle all the way,
Oh what fun it is to ride,
In a one horse open sleigh.
Jingle bells, jingle bells,
Jingle all the way,
Oh what fun it is to ride,
In a one horse open sleigh.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Dashing through the snow,
In a one horse open sleigh,
O'er the fields we go,
Laughing all the way,
Bells on bobtail ring,
Making spirits bright.
What fun it is to ride and sing,
A sleighing song tonight.

sections.label: Chorus 2
sections.lyrics:
Ring the bells, ring the bells
Ring them out today.
Echoing through all the world
Listen what they say
Ring the bells, ring the bells
Ring them all the way.
Spread the message far and wide
That Christ is born today.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Join all the glorious names,
Of wisdom love and power;
That ever mortals knew,
That angels ever bore.
All are too mean to speak His worth,
Too mean to set my Savior forth.

sections.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4
Verse 5
Verse 6
sections.lyrics:
Should all the hosts of death
And powers of hell unknown
Put their most dreadful forms
Of rage and malice on,
I shall be safe for Christ displays,
Superior power and guardian grace.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Joy to the world! the Lord is come;
Let earth receive her King.
Let every heart prepare Him room,
And heav'n and nature sing,
And heav'n and nature sing,
And heav'n and heav'n and nature sing.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Joy to the earth! the Savior reigns;
Let men their songs employ.
While fields and floods,
Rocks, hills and plains,
Repeat the sounding joy,
Repeat the sounding joy,
Repeat, repeat the sounding joy.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
No more let sins and sorrows grow,
Nor thorns infest the ground.
He comes to make His blessings flow,
Far as the curse is found,
Far as the curse is found,
Far as, far as the curse is found.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
He rules the world with truth and grace
And makes the nations prove.
The glories of His righteousness
And wonders of His love,
And wonders of His love,
And wonders, and wonders of His love.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
It is joy unspeakable and full of glory,
Full of glory, full of glory.
It is joy unspeakable and full of glory.
Oh the half has never yet been told!

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I have found His grace in all complete;
He supplieth every need.
While I sit and learn at Jesus feet,
I am free, yes, free indeed.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
I have found the pleasure I once craved;
It is joy and peace within.
What a wondrous blessing! I am saved
From the awful gulf of sin.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
I have found that hope
so bright and clear,
Living in the realm of grace.
Oh the Savior's presence is so near,
I can see His smiling face.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
I have found the joy no tongue can tell.
How its waves of glory roll!
It is like a great o'er flowing well
Springing up within my soul.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Lead me, Lord,
Lead me in Thy righteousness;
Make Thy way plain before my face.
For it is Thou, Lord,
Thou, Lord, only,
That makest me dwell in safety.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Lead on, O King Eternal.
The day of march has come;
Henceforth in fields of conquest
Thy tents shall be our home.
Thro' days of preparation
Thy grace has made us strong;
And now, O King eternal,
We lift our battle song.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Lead on, O King Eternal,
Till sin's fierce war shall cease,
And holiness shall whisper
The sweet Amen of peace.
For not with swords loud clashing,
Nor roll of stirring drums;
With deeds of love and mercy,
The heav'nly kingdom comes.

sections.label: Verse 3

title: Leaning On The Everlasting Arms
artist: Anthony J. Showalter, Elisha A. Hoffman

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Leaning, leaning,
Safe and secure from all alarms;
Leaning, leaning,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
What a fellowship, what a joy divine,
Leaning on the everlasting arms!
What a blessedness, what a peace is mine,
Leaning on the everlasting arms!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Oh how sweet to walk in this pilgrim way,
Leaning on the everlasting arms!
Oh how bright the path
Grows from day to day,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
What have I to dread, what have I to fear,
Leaning on the everlasting arms?
I have blessed peace with my Lord so near,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.

title: Living For Jesus
artist: C. Harold Lowden, Thomas Obediah Chisholm

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
O Jesus, Lord and Savior,
I give myself to Thee.
For Thou in Thy atonement,
Didst give Thyself for me.
I own no other master,
My heart shall be Thy throne.
My life I give henceforth to live,
O Christ for Thee alone.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Living for Jesus, a life that is true.
Striving to please Him in all that I do.
Yielding allegiance glad hearted and free.
This is the pathway of blessing for me.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Living for Jesus who died in my place,
Bearing on Calvary, my sin and disgrace.
Such love constrains me, to answer His call,
Follow His leading and give Him my all.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Living for Jesus, wherever I am.
Doing each duty in His holy name.
Willing to suffer affliction or loss.
Deeming each trial, a part of my cross.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Living for Jesus, through earth's little while,
My dearest treasure, the light of His smile.
Seeking the lost ones, He died to redeem.
Bringing the weary to find rest in Him.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Our Father who art in Heaven,
Hallowed be Thy name.
Thy kingdom come, Thy will be done,
On earth as it is in heaven.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Give us this day our daily bread;
And forgive us our trespasses
As we forgive those
Who trespass against us.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
And lead us not into temptation,
But deliver us from evil,
For thine is the kingdom,
And the power and the glory forever.
Amen.

sections.label: Chorus
Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
It was love that sent a Savior
To this world of sin and woe,
It was love that left Heaven's portals,
And came down to dwell below;
It was love that stilled the waters
On the stormy Galilee;
It was love that paid sin's ransom,
One dark day on Calvary.

sections.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Love lifted me!
Love lifted me!
When nothing else could help,
Love lifted me.
Love lifted me.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I was sinking deep in sin,
Far from the peaceful shore,
Very deeply stained within,
Sinking to rise no more.
But the Master of the sea
Heard my despairing cry,
From the waters lifted me;
Now safe am I.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
All my heart to Him I give;
Ever to Him I'll cling,
In His blessed presence live,
Ever His praises sing.
Love so mighty and so true
Merits my soul's best songs;
Faithful, loving service, too,
To Him belongs.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Souls in danger, look above;
Jesus completely saves.
He will lift you by His love
Out of the angry waves.
He's the Master of the sea,
Billows His will obey.
He your Savior wants to be,
Be saved today.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Majestic sweetness sits enthroned,
Upon the Savior's brow;
His head with radiant glories crowned,
His lips with grace o'erflow,
His lips with grace o'erflow.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
No mortal can with Him compare
Among the sons of men;
Fairer is He than all the fair
Who fill the heav'nly train,
Who fill the heav'nly train.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
He saw me plunged in deep distress,
He flew to my relief;
For me He bore the shameful Cross,
And carried all my grief,
And carried all my grief.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
To Him I owe my life and breath
And all the joys I have;
He makes me triumph over death,
And saves me from the grave,
And saves me from the grave.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Since from His bounty I receive
Such proofs of love divine,
Had I a thousand hearts to give,
Lord they should all be Thine;
Lord they should all be Thine.

title: More About Jesus
artist: Eliza E. Hewitt, John R. Sweney

sections.label: Chorus
Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
More about Jesus would I know,
More of His grace to others show;
More of His saving fullness see,
More of His love who died for me.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
More about Jesus let me learn,
More of His holy will discern;
Spirit of God, my teacher be,
Showing the things of Christ to me.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
More about Jesus in His word,
Holding communion with my Lord,
Hearing His voice in every line,
Making each faithful saying mine.

sections.label: Verse 4
Chorus
Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
More love to Thee, O Christ,
More love to Thee!
Hear Thou the prayer,
I make on bended knee.
This is my earnest plea:

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Once earthly joy I craved,
Sought peace and rest.
Now Thee alone I seek;
Give what is best.
This all my prayer shall be:

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Then shall my latest breath
Whisper Thy praise.
This be the parting cry
My heart shall raise;
This still my prayer shall be:

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Let sorrow do its work,
Send grief and pain;
Sweet are Thy messengers,
Sweet their refrain,
When they can sing with me:

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Rolled away, rolled away,
I am happy since my burdens rolled away.
Rolled away, rolled away,
I am happy since my burdens rolled away.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I Remember when my burdens rolled away;
I had carried them for years, night and day.
When I sought the blessed Lord
And I took Him at His word,
Then at once all my burdens rolled away.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
I remember when my burdens rolled away,
That I feared would never leave night or day,
Jesus showed to me the loss,
So I left them at the Cross;
I was glad when my burdens rolled away.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
I remember when my burdens rolled away,
That had hindered me for years,
Night and day.
As I sought the throne of grace,
Just a glimpse of Jesus' face,
And I knew that my burdens
Could not stay.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
I am singing
Since my burdens rolled away;
There's a song within my heart
Night and day.
I am living for my King,
And with joy I shout and sing,
Hallelujah!
All my burdens rolled away!

title: My Faith Looks Up To Thee

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
My faith looks up to Thee,
Thou Lamb of Calvary,
Savior divine!
Now hear me while I pray;
Take all my guilt away.
Oh let me from this day
Be wholly Thine!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
May Thy rich grace impart
Strength to my fainting heart,
My zeal inspire.
As Thou hast died for me,
Oh may my love to Thee
Pure, warm and changeless be,
A living fire.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
While life's dark maze I tread,
And griefs around me spread
Be Thou my Guide.
Bid darkness turn to day;
Wipe sorrow's tears away;
Nor let me ever stray
From Thee aside!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
When ends life's transient dream,
When death's cold sullen stream
Shall o'er me roll,
Blest Savior, then in love,
Fear and distrust remove.
Oh bear me safe above,
A ransomed soul.

title: My Jesus I Love Thee
artist: Adoniram J. Gordon, William R. Featherston

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
My Jesus I love Thee;
I know Thou art mine.
For Thee all the follies
Of sin I resign.
My gracious Redeemer,
My Savior art Thou.
If ever I loved Thee,
My Jesus, 'tis now.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
I love Thee,
Because Thou hast first loved me,
And purchased my pardon
On Calvary's tree.
I love Thee
For wearing the thorns
On Thy brow,
If ever I loved Thee,
My Jesus, 'tis now.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
I'll love Thee in life,
I will love Thee in death,
And praise Thee
As long as Thou lendest me breath;
And say when the death dew
Lies cold on my brow,
"If ever I loved Thee,
My Jesus 'tis now."

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
In mansions of glory
And endless delight,
I'll ever adore Thee
In heaven so bright.
I'll sing with the glittering crown
On my brow,
"If ever I loved Thee,
My Jesus, 'tis now."

title: My Soul Be On Thy Guard

sections.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Oh, watch and fight and pray;
The battle ne'er give o'er.
Renew it boldly ev'ry day,
And help divine implore.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Ne'er think the vict'ry won,
Nor lay thine armor down;
The work of faith will not be done
Till thou obtain the crown.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Fight on, my soul, till death
Shall bring thee to thy God;
He'll take thee, at thy parting breath,
To His divine abode.

sections.label: Chorus
Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer to Thee,
E'en though it be a cross
That raiseth me!
Still all my song shall be,

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Though like the wanderer,
The sun gone down,
Darkness be over me,
My rest a stone;
Yet in my dreams I'd be,

sections.label: Verse 3
Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Then, with my waking thoughts
Bright with Thy praise,
Out of my stony griefs
Bethel I'll raise,
So by my woes to be,

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Or if, on joyful wing
Cleaving the sky,
Sun, moon, and stars forgot,
Upward I fly,
Still all my song shall be,

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Nearer, still nearer
Close to Thy heart,
Draw me, my Savior
So precious Thou art!
Fold me oh fold me
To Thy breast,
Shelter me safe
In that "Haven of Rest";
Shelter me safe
In that "Haven of Rest."

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Nearer, still nearer
Nothing I bring,
Naught as an offering
To Jesus, my King;
Only my sinful,
Now contrite heart.
Grant me the cleansing
Thy blood doth impart,
Grant me the cleansing
Thy blood doth impart.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Nearer, still nearer
While life shall last,
Till safe in glory
My anchor is cast;
Through endless ages ever to be,
Nearer, my Savior
Still nearer to Thee,
Nearer my Savior
Still nearer to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Nearer, still nearer
Lord to be Thine!
Sin with its follies
I gladly resign,
All of its pleasures,
Pomp and its pride.
Give me but Jesus
My Lord crucified;
Give me but Jesus
My Lord crucified.

sections.label: Chorus
Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
What can wash away my sin?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
What can make me whole again?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Nothing can for sin atone,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
Naught of good that I have done,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
This is all my hope and peace,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
This is all my righteousness,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

title: Now Thank We All Our God
artist: Ahasverus Fritsch, Catherine Winkworth, Johann Sebastian Bach

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Now thank we all our God,
With heart, and hands, and voices,
Who wondrous things hath done,
In whom His world rejoices;
Who from our mother's arms
Hath blessed us on our way
With countless gifts of love,
And still is ours today.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
O may this bounteous God
Thro' all our life be near us,
With ever joyful hearts
And blessed peace to cheer us;
And keep us in His grace,
And guide us when perplexed,
And free us from all ills,
In this world and the next.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
All praise and thanks to God
The Father now be given, the Son,
And Him who reigns with them
In highest heaven,
The one eternal God,
Whom earth and heav'n adore;
For thus it was, is now,
And shall be evermore.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
O Christmas tree O Christmas tree,
You stand in verdant beauty.
O Christmas tree O Christmas tree,
You stand in verdant beauty.
Your boughs are green in summer's glow,
And do not fade in winter's snow.
O Christmas tree O Christmas tree,
You stand in verdant beauty.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
O Christmas tree, O Christmas tree,
Thy leaves are so unchanging,
O Christmas tree, O Christmas tree,
Thy leaves are so unchanging;
Not only green when summer's here,
But also when 'tis cold and drear.
O Christmas tree, O Christmas tree,
Thy leaves are so unchanging!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
O Christmas tree, O Christmas tree,
Thy candles shine so brightly,
O Christmas tree, O Christmas tree,
Thy candles shine so brightly!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
O Christmas Tree, O Christmas Tree,
You bear a wondrous message!
O Christmas Tree, O Christmas Tree,
You bear a wondrous message!
You do proclaim the Savior's birth,
Good will to men and peace on earth.
O Christmas Tree, O Christmas Tree,
You bear a wondrous message!

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
O Christmas Tree, O Christmas tree,
Of all the trees most lovely;
O Christmas tree, O Christmas tree,
Of all the trees most lovely;
Each year you bring to me delight
Gleaming in the Christmas night.
O christmas tree, O Christmas tree,
Of all the trees most lovely.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.lyrics:
O Christmas tree, O Christmas tree,
Your leaves will teach me also,
O Christmas tree, O Christmas tree,
Your leaves will teach me also
That hope and love and faithfulness
Are precious things I can possess.
O Christmas tree, O Christmas tree,
Your leaves will teach me also.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
O come all ye faithful,
Joyful and triumphant,
O come ye, O come ye to Bethlehem;
Come and behold Him,
Born the King of angels:

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
Christ the Lord.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
God of God,
Light of light,
Lo! He abhors not the virgin's womb;
Very God,
Begotton not created:

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Sing, choirs of angels,
Sing in exultation,
Sing all ye citizens of heaven above:
Glory to God
In the highest:

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Yea, Lord, we greet Thee,
Born this happy morning,
Jesu, to Thee be glory given;
Word of the Father,
Now in flesh appearing:

title: O Come O Come Emmanuel
artist: Henry S. Coffin, John M. Neale, Thomas Helmore

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Rejoice! Rejoice! Emmanuel,
Shall come to thee, O Israel!

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
O come, O come Emmanuel
And ransom captive Israel,
That mourns in lonely exile here
Until the Son of God appear.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
O come, thou Wisdom from on high,
And order all things far and nigh;
To us the path of knowledge show
And cause us in her ways to go.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
O come, O come, great Lord of might,
Who to Thy tribes on Sinai's height
In ancient times once gave the law
In cloud and majesty and awe.

sections.label: Verse 4
Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
O come, thou Key of David, come,
And open wide our heavenly home.
The captives from their prison free,
And conquer death's deep misery.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.lyrics:
O come, thou Dayspring, come and cheer
Our spirits by Thy justice here;
Disperse the gloomy clouds of night,
And death's dark shadows put to flight.

sections.label: Verse 7
sections.lyrics:
O come, Desire of nations bind
All peoples in one heart and mind.
From dust Thou brought us forth to life;
Deliver us from earthly strife.

title: O Could I Speak The Matchless Worth

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
O could I speak the matchless worth,
O could I sound the glories forth,
Which in my Savior shine?
I'd sing His glorious righteousness
And magnify the wondrous grace
Which made salvation mine;
Which made salvation mine.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
I'd sing the precious blood He spilt,
My ransom from the dreadful guilt
Of sin, and wrath divine;
I'd sing His glorious righteousness,
In which all perfect, heavenly dress,
My soul shall ever shine;
My soul shall ever shine.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
I'd sing the characters He bears
And all the forms of love He wears,
Exalted on His throne;
In loftiest songs of sweetest praise,
I would to everlasting days,
Make all His glories known;
Make all His glories known.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Soon the delightful day will come,
When my dear Lord will bring me home
And I shall see His face;
Then with my Savior brother friend,
A blest eternity I'll spend,
Triumphant in His grace;
Triumphant in His grace.
Amen.

title: O For A Faith That Will Not Shrink
artist: Carl G. Glaser, William H. Bathurst

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
O for a faith that will not shrink,
Tho' pressed by ev'ry foe,
That will not tremble on the brink
Of any earthly woe!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
That will not murmur nor complain,
Beneath the chastening rod
But in the hour of grief or pain,
Will lean upon its God.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
A faith that shines more bright and clear
When tempests rage without;
That when in danger knows no fear,
In darkness feels no doubt.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
That bears, unmoved, the world's dread frown,
Nor heeds its scornful smile;
That seas of trouble cannot drown,
Nor Satan's arts beguile.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Lord give us such a faith as this;
And then whate'er may come,
We'll taste e'en here the hollowed bliss,
Of an eternal home.

title: O For A Heart To Praise My God

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
O for a heart to praise my God,
A heart from sin set free,
A heart that always feels thy blood
So freely shed for me.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
A heart resigned, submissive, meek,
My great Redeemer's throne,
Where only Christ is heard to speak,
Where Jesus reigns alone.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
A humble, lowly, contrite heart,
Believing, true, and clean,
Which neither life nor death can part
From Christ who dwells within.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
A heart in every thought renewed
And full of love divine,
Perfect and right and pure and good,
A copy, Lord, of thine.

sections.label: Verse 5

title: O For A Thousand Tongues To Sing

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
O for a thousand tongues to sing
My great Redeemer's praise,
The glories of my God and King,
The triumphs of His grace!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
My gracious Master and my God,
Assist me to proclaim,
To spread through all the earth abroad,
The honors of Thy name.

sections.label: Verse 3
Verse 4
Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Hear Him, ye deaf, His praise, ye dumb,
Your loosened tongues employ.
Ye blind, behold your Savior come,
And leap ye lame for joy.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.lyrics:
Glory to God and praise and love
Be ever, ever giv'n
By saints below and saints above
The church in earth and heav'n.

title: O God Our Help In Ages Past

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
O God, our Help in ages past,
Our Hope for years to come,
Our Shelter from the stormy blast,
And our eternal Home!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Under the shadow of Thy throne
Still may we dwell secure;
Sufficient is Thine arm alone,
And our defense is sure.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Before the hills in order stood,
Or earth received her frame,
From everlasting Thou art God,
To endless years the same.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
O God, our Help in ages past,
Our Hope for years to come,
Be Thou my Guide while life shall last,
And our eternal Home.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
A thousand ages in Thy sight,
Are like and evening gone;
Short as the watch that ends the night,
Before the rising sun.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.lyrics:
Time like an ever rolling stream,
Bears all its sons away;
They fly, forgotten, as a dream
Die at the op'ning day.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Happy day, happy day,
When Jesus washed my sins away!
He taught me how to watch and pray,
And live rejoicing every day.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
O happy day that fixed my choice
On Thee, my Savior and my God!
Well may this glowing heart rejoice,
And tell its raptures all abroad.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Tis done, the great transaction's done;
I am my Lord's and He is mine.
He drew me and I followed on,
Charmed to confess the voice divine.

sections.label: Verse 3
Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
O happy bond that seals my vows
To Him who merits all my love!
Let cheerful anthems fill His house,
While to that sacred shrine I move.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
High heaven, that heard the solemn vow,
That vow renewed shall daily hear,
Till in life's latest hour I bow
And bless in death a bond so dear.

title: O Holy Night
artist: Adolphe Adam, Chappeau de Roquemaure, John S. Dwight

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Fall on your knees!
Oh hear the angel voices!
Oh night divine!
Oh night when Christ was born,
Oh night divine!
Oh night, oh night divine!

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
O holy night!
The stars are brightly shining;
It is the night
Of the dear Savior's birth.
Long lay the world
In sin and error pining;
Till He appeared
And the soul felt its worth.
A thrill of hope,
The weary world rejoices;
For yonder breaks,
A new and glorious morn.
Fall on your knees,

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Led by the light
Of faith serenely beaming,
With glowing hearts
By His cradle we stand.
So led by light
Of a star sweetly gleaming,
Here came the wise men
From orient land.
The King of kings
Lay thus in lowly manger,
In all our trials
Born to be our Friend;
He knows our need
To our weakness is no stranger.
Behold your King
Before Him lowly bend;
Behold your King
Before Him lowly bend!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Truly He taught us
To love one another,
His law is love
And His gospel is peace;
Chains shall He break
For the slave is our brother,
And in His name
All oppression shall cease.
Sweet hymns of joy
In grateful chorus raise we,
Let all within us
Praise His holy name.
Christ is the Lord
O praise His name forever.
His power and glory evermore proclaim;
His power and glory evermore proclaim.

sections.label: Chorus 1
sections.lyrics:
O, how I love Jesus,
O, how I love Jesus,
O, how I love Jesus;
Because He first loved me.

sections.label: Chorus 2
sections.lyrics:
To me He is so wonderful,
To me He is so wonderful,
To me He is so wonderful;
Because He first loved me.

sections.label: Chorus 3
sections.lyrics:
O, how I love God's Word,
O, how I love God's Word,
O, how I love God's Word;
It tells of His love for me.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
There is a name I love to hear,
I love to sing its worth;
It sounds like music in my ear,
The sweetest name on earth.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
It tells me of a Savior's love,
Who died to set me free;
It tells me of His precious blood,
The sinner's perfect plea.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
It tells me what my Father hath,
In store for ev'ry day;
And tho' I tread a darksome path,
Yields sunshine all the way.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
It tells of One whose loving heart,
Can feel my deepest woe;
Who in each sorrow bears a part,
That none can bear below.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
O little town of Bethlehem,
How still we see thee lie;
Above thy deep and dreamless sleep,
The silent stars go by.
Yet in thy dark streets shineth
The everlasting Light;
The hopes and fears of all the years,
Are met in thee tonight.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
For Christ is born of Mary
And gathered all above;
While mortals sleep the angels keep
Their watch of wondering love.
O, morning stars together
Proclaim the holy birth;
And praises sing to God the King
And peace to men on earth.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
How silently, how silently,
The wondrous gift is giv'n;
So God imparts to human hearts,
The blessings of His heaven.
No ear may hear His coming,
But in this world of sin;
Where meek souls will
Receive Him still,
The dear Christ enters in.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
O, holy child of Bethlehem,
Descend to us we pray;
Cast out our sin and enter in,
Be born in us today.
We hear the Christmas angels,
The great glad tidings tell;
O, come to us abide with us,
Our Lord, Emmanuel.

title: O Love That Will Not Let Me Go

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
O love that will not let me go,
I rest my weary soul in Thee.
I give Thee back the life I owe,
That in Thine ocean depths its flow,
May richer fuller be.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
O light that foll'west all my way,
I yield my flick'ring torch to Thee.
My heart restores its borrowed ray,
That in Thy sunshine's blaze it's day,
May brighter fairer be.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
O joy that seekest me through pain,
I cannot close my heart to Thee.
I trace the rainbow through the rain,
And feel the promise is not vain,
That morn shall tearless be.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
O cross that lifted up my head,
I dare not ask to fly from Thee.
I lay in dust life's glory dead,
And from the ground there blossoms red,
Life that shall endless be.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
O Thou in whose presence
My soul takes delight,
On Whom in affliction I call
My Comfort by day
And my Song in the night,
My Hope, my Salvation, my All!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Where dost Thou, dear Shepherd,
Resort with Thy sheep.
To feed them in pastures of love?
Say, why in the valley,
Of death should I weep,
Or alone in this wilderness rove?

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
O, why should I wander,
An alien from Thee,
Or cry in the desert
For bread?
Thy foes will rejoice,
When my sorrows they see,
And smile at the tears,
I have shed.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Ye daughters of Zion declare,
Have you seen the star,
That on Israel shone.
Say if in your tents,
My beloved has been,
And where with His flocks
He is gone.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
He looks! And ten thousands
Of angels rejoice,
And myriads wait for His word.
He speaks! And eternity,
Filled with His voice,
Re-echoes the praise of the Lord.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.lyrics:
Dear Shepherd! I hear,
And will follow Thy call;
I know the sweet sound of Thy voice.
Restore and defend me,
For Thou art my all,
And in Thee I will ever rejoice.

title: O Worship The King
artist: Johann Michael Haydn, Robert Grant, William Gardiner

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
O worship the King,
All glorious above,
And gratefully sing
His power and His love:
Our Shield and Defender,
The Ancient of Days,
Pavilioned in splendor,
And girded with praise.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
O tell of His might,
And sing of His grace,
Whose robe is the light,
Whose canopy space.
His chariots of wrath,
The deep thunderclouds form,
And dark is His path
On the wings of the storm.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Thy bountiful care,
What tongue can recite?
It breathes in the air;
It shines in the light.
It streams from the hills;
It descends to the plain,
And sweetly distills
In the dew and the rain.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Frail children of dust,
And feeble as frail,
In Thee do we trust,
Nor find Thee to fail.
Thy mercies how tender!
How firm to the end!
Our Maker, Defender,
Redeemer, and Friend!

title: Of The Father's Love Begotten
artist: Henry Williams Baker, John Mason Neale, Marcus Aurelius Clemens Prudentius

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Of the Father's love begotten,
Ere the world began to be;
He is Alpha and Omega,
He the source, the ending He.
Of the things that are that have been
And that future years shall see;
Evermore and evermore!

sections.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Christ, to Thee with God the Father,
And, O Holy Ghost, to Thee;
Hymn and chant and high thanksgiving
And unwearied praises be:
Honor, glory, and dominion and eternal victory;
Evermore and evermore!
Amen.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
O that birth forever blessed
When the Virgin, full of grace,
By the Holy Ghost conceiving,
Bare the Savior of our race;
And the Babe, the world's Redeemer
First revealed His sacred face,
Evermore and evermore!

title: Once In Royal David's City
artist: Cecil Frances Humphreys Alexander, Henry John Gauntlett

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Once in royal David's city,
Stood a lowly cattle shed;
Where a mother laid her baby,
In a manger for His bed.
Mary was that mother mild,
Jesus Christ, her little Child.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
He came down to earth from heaven,
Who is God and Lord of all;
And His shelter was a stable,
And His cradle was a stall.
With the poor and meek and lowly,
Lived on earth, our Savior holy.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Jesus is our childhood's pattern,
Day by day like us He grew;
He was little, weak and helpless,
Tears and smiles like us He knew.
And He feels for all our sadness,
And He shares in all our gladness.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
And our eyes at last shall see Him,
Through His own redeeming love,
For that Child so dear and gentle,
Is our Lord in heaven above;
And He leads His children on,
To the place where He has gone.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Not in that poor lowly stable,
With the oxen standing by;
We shall see Him but in heaven,
Set at God's right hand on high.
There His children gather round,
Bright like stars with glory crowned.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.lyrics:
And through all
His wondrous childhood
He would honor and obey,
Love and watch the lowly maiden
In whose gentle arms He lay;
Christian children,
All must be mild, obedient,
Good as He.

title: Open My Eyes That I May See

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Open my eyes that I may see
Glimpses of truth Thou hast for me;
Place in my hands the wonderful key
That shall unclasp and set me free.
Silently now I wait for Thee,
Ready my God Thy will to see.
Open my eyes. Illumine me, Spirit divine!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Open my ears that I may hear
Voices of truth Thou sendest clear;
And while the wave-notes fall on my ear,
Everything false will disappear.
Silently now I wait for Thee,
Ready my God Thy will to see.
Open my ears, Illumine me, Spirit divine!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Open my mouth and let me bear
Gladly the warm truth everywhere.
Open my heart and let me prepare
Love with Thy children thus to share.
Silently now I wait for Thee,
Ready my God Thy will to see.
Open my heart. Illumine me, Spirit divine!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Open my mind that I may read
More of Thy love in word and deed.
What shall I fear while yet Thou dost lead?
Only for light from Thee I plead.
Silently now I wait for Thee,
Ready, my God, Thy will to see.
Open my mind. Illumine me, Spirit divine!

title: Our Day Of Joy Is Here Again

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Glory to our God, we sing,
Glory to our Lord and King;
Peace, goodwill with all abide,
This holy Christmas tide.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Our day of joy is here again,
With love and peace and song;
Come, let us join the angelic strain
With voices clear and strong.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
When darkness lay upon the earth,
A glorious light did shine;
God sent a Gift of priceless worth
And showed His love divine.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Now to the manger let us go
To worship and adore;
The tender Babe upon the straw,
Our Savior evermore.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
How wonderful that God's own Son
Should so Himself abase!
He thrust the mighty from their throne,
And gave the lowly grace.

title: Our Great Savior
artist: J. Wilbur Chapman, Rowland H. Prichard

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Hallelujah what a Savior.
Hallelujah what a Friend.
Saving, helping, keeping, loving,
He is with me to the end.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Jesus! What a friend for sinners!
Jesus lover of my soul!
Friends may fail me, foes assail me;
He, my Savior, makes me whole.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Jesus! What a strength in weakness!
Let me hide myself in Him;
Tempted tried and sometimes failing,
He, my strength my victory wins.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Jesus! What a help in sorrow!
While the billows o'er me roll,
Even when my heart is breaking,
He, my Comfort helps my soul.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Jesus! What a guide and keeper!
While the tempest still is high,
Storms about me, night o'ertakes me,
He, my pilot hears my cry.

sections.label: Verse 5

title: Pass Me Not
artist: Fanny J. Crosby, William H. Doane

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Savior, Savior, hear my humble cry.
While on others Thou art calling,
Do not pass me by.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Pass me not, O gentle Savior;
Hear my humble cry.
While on others Thou art calling,
Do not pass me by.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Let me at Thy throne of mercy
Find a sweet relief;
Kneeling there in deep contrition,
Help my unbelief.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Trusting only in Thy merit,
Would I seek Thy face.
Heal my wounded, broken spirit.
Save me by Thy grace.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Thou, the Spring of all my comfort,
More than life to me,
Whom have I on earth beside Thee?
Whom in heaven but Thee?

title: Praise Him Praise Him
artist: Chester G. Allen, Fanny Jane Crosby

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Praise Him! Praise Him!
Tell of His excellent greatness,
Praise Him! Praise Him!
Ever in joyful song.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Praise Him! Praise Him!
Jesus our blessed Redeemer!
Sing, O earth,
His wonderful love proclaim,
Hail Him! Hail Him!
Highest archangels in glory,
Strength and honor
Give to His holy name.
Like a shepherd
Jesus will guard His children,
In His arms He carries them
All day long.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Praise Him! Praise Him!
Jesus our blessed Redeemer!
For our sins He suffered
And bled and died,
He, our Rock,
Our hope of eternal salvation,
Hail Him! Hail Him!
Jesus the Crucified.
Sound His praises,
Jesus who bore our sorrows,
Love unbounded,
Wonderful, deep and strong.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Praise Him! Praise Him!
Jesus our blessed Redeemer.
Heavenly portals,
Loud with hosannas ring,
Jesus, Savior,
Reigneth forever and ever,
Crown Him! Crown Him!
Prophet and Priest and King.
Christ is coming
Over the world victorious;
Power and glory
Unto the Lord belong.

title: Praise My Soul The King Of Heaven

sections.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Praise Him for His grace and favor
To our fathers in distress.
Praise Him, still the same forever.
Slow to chide and swift to bless:
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Glorious in His faithfulness!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Father-like He tends and spares us.
Well our feeble frame He knows;
In His hands He gently bears us,
Rescues us from all our foes:
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Widely yet His mercy flows!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Angels in the height, adore Him,
Ye behold Him face to face;
Sun and moon, bow down before Him,
Dwellers all in time and space:
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Praise with us the God of grace!

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Frail as summer's flow'r we flourish;
Blows the wind and it is gone;
But, while mortals rise and perish,
God endures unchanging on:
Praise Him, praise Him,
Praise Him, praise Him,
Praise with us the God of grace.

title: Praise My Soul The King Of Heaven

sections.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Praise Him, for His grace and favor,
To our fathers in distress;
Praise Him, still the same as ever,
Slow to chide and swift to bless,
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Glorious in His faithfulness.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Frail as summer's flow'r we flourish,
Blows the wind and it is gone;
But while mortals rise and perish,
God endures unchanging on.
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Praise the high Eternal One.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Angels in the height, adore Him,
Ye behold Him face to face;
Saints triumphant, bow before Him,
Gathered in from every race.
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Praise with us, the God of grace.

title: Praise The Lord Ye Heavens Adore Him

sections.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Praise the Savior, ye who know Him!
Who can tell how much we owe Him?
Gladly let us render to Him
All we are and have.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Jesus is the name that charms us,
He for conflict fits and arms us;
Nothing moves and nothing harms us
While we trust in Him.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Trust in Him, ye saints, forever;
He is faithful, changing never.
Neither force nor guile can sever
Those He loves from Him.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Keep us, Lord,
O keep us cleaving to Thyself
And still believing;
'Til the hour of our receiving,
Promised joys with Thee.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Then we shall be where we would be,
Then we shall be what we should be;
Things that are not now, nor could be,
Soon shall be our own.

title: Praise To The Lord The Almighty

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Praise to the Lord, the Almighty,
The King of creation!
O my soul, praise Him,
For He is thy health and salvation!
All ye who hear,
Now to His temple draw near;
Join me in glad adoration!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Praise to the Lord,
Who o'er all things
So wondrously reigneth,
Shelters thee under His wings,
Yes, so gently sustaineth!
Hast Thou not seen
How all thy longings have been
Granted in what He ordaineth?

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Praise to the Lord!
O let all that is in me adore Him!
All that hath life and breath,
Come now with praises before Him.
Let the amen sound from His people again:
Gladly for aye we adore Him.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Praise to the Lord,
Who doth prosper
Thy work and defend thee;
Surely His goodness and mercy
Here daily attend thee.
Ponder anew what the Almighty can do,
If with His love He befriend thee.

sections.label: Chorus 1
sections.lyrics:
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice;
Rejoice; again I say, rejoice.

sections.label: Chorus 2
sections.lyrics:
We soon shall hear the archangel's voice;
The trump of God shall sound, rejoice!

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Rejoice, the Lord is King!
Your Lord and King adore;
Mortals, give thanks and sing,
And triumph evermore.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Jesus the Savior reigns,
The God of truth and love;
When He had purged our stains,
He took His seat above.

sections.label: Verse 3
Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Rejoice in glorious hope!
Jesus the Judge shall come
And take His servants up
To their eternal home.

title: Revive Us Again
artist: John J. Husband, William P. MacKay

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Hallelujah! Thine the glory!
Hallelujah! Amen!
Hallelujah! Thine the glory!
Revive us again.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
We praise Thee, O God,
For the Son of Thy love;
For Jesus, who died
And is now gone above.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
We praise Thee, O God,
For Thy Spirit of light,
Who has shown us our Savior
And scattered our night.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
All glory and praise
To the Lamb that was slain,
Who has borne all our sins
And hath cleansed every stain.

sections.label: Verse 4

title: Ring The Bells Of Heaven
artist: George F. Root, William O. Cushing

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Glory! Glory! How the angels sing!
Glory! Glory! How the loud harps ring!
'Tis the ransomed army, like a mighty sea,
Pealing forth the anthem of the free.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Ring the bells of heaven!
There is joy today,
For a soul returning from the wild!
See the Father meets Him out upon the way,
Welcoming His weary wand'ring child.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Ring the bells of heaven!
There is joy today,
For the wand'rer now is reconciled.
Yes a soul is rescued from His sinful way,
And is born anew a ransomed child.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Ring the bells of heaven!
Spread the feast today!
Angels swell the glad triumphant strain!
Tell the joyful tidings;
Bear it far away!
For a precious soul is born again.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee.
Let the water and the blood,
From Thy wounded side which flowed,
Be of sin the double cure,
Save from wrath and make me pure.

sections.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
While I draw this fleeting breath,
When my eyes shall close in death,
When I rise to worlds unknown,
And behold Thee on Thy throne,
Rock of Ages cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee.

sections.label: Verse 5

title: Satisfied
artist: Clara Teare Williams, Ralph E. Hudson

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Hallelujah! I have found Him
Whom my soul so long has craved!
Jesus satisfies my longings;
Thro' His blood I now am saved.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
All my lifelong I had panted,
For a draught from some cool spring
That I hoped would quench the burning
Of the thirst I felt within.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Feeding on the husks around me
Till my strength was almost gone,
Longed my soul for something better,
Only still to hunger on.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Poor I was and sought for riches,
Something that would satisfy;
But the dust I gathered round me
Only mocked my soul's sad cry.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Well of water, ever springing,
Bread of life, so rich and free,
Untold wealth that never faileth,
My Redeemer is to me.

title: Saved
artist: Oswald J. Smith, Roger M. Hickman

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Saved! I'm saved thro' Christ,
My all in all.
Saved! I'm saved,
Whatever may befall.
He died upon the cross for me,
He bore the awful penalty.
And now I'm saved eternally,
I'm saved! Saved! Saved!

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Saved! Saved! Saved!
My sins are all forgiv'n,
Christ is mine!
I'm on my way to heaven,
Once a guilty sinner, lost, undone,
Now a child of God,
Saved thro' His Son.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Saved! Saved! Saved!
By grace and grace alone.
Oh, what wondrous love
To me was shown,
In my stead
Christ Jesus bled and died.
Bore my sins,
For me was crucified.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Saved! Saved! Saved!
Oh joy beyond compare!
Christ my life,
And I His constant care,
Yielding all and trusting Him alone,
Living now each moment as His own.

title: Savior Like A Shepherd Lead Us

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Savior, like a shepherd lead us;
Much we need Your tender care.
In Your pleasant pastures feed us,
For our use Your folds prepare.
Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus,
You have bought us: Yours we are.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
We are Yours; in love befriend us,
Be the guardian of our way;
Keep Your flock, from sin defend us,
Seek us when we go astray.
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus,
Hear Your children when we pray.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
You have promised to receive us,
Poor and sinful though we be;
You have mercy to relieve us,
Grace to cleanse, and power to free.
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus,
Early let us turn to You.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Early let us seek Your favor,
Early let us do Your will;
Blessed Lord and only Savior,
With Your love our spirits fill.
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus,
You have loved us; love us still.

title: Silent Night Holy Night
artist: Franz Gruber, John Freeman Young, Joseph Mohr

sections.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Silent night, holy night,
Shepherds quake at the sight.
Glories stream from heaven afar,
Heavenly hosts sing "Alleluia.
Christ the Savior is born;
Christ the Savior is born."

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Silent night, holy night,
Son of God, love's pure light.
Radiant beams from Thy holy face,
With the dawn of redeeming grace.
Jesus, Lord, at Thy birth;
Jesus, Lord, at Thy birth.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Silent night, holy night,
Wondrous star, lend thy light.
With the angels, let us sing,
Alleluia to our King.
Christ the Savior is born;
Christ the Savior is born.

title: Since Jesus Came Into My Heart
artist: Charles H. Gabriel, Rufus H. McDaniel

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Since Jesus came into my heart,
Since Jesus came into my heart,
Floods of joy o'er my soul
Like the sea billows roll,
Since Jesus came into my heart.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
What a wonderful change
In my life has been wrought
Since Jesus came into my heart!
I have light in my soul,
For which long I have sought,
Since Jesus came into my heart.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
I have ceased from my
Wandering and going astray
Since Jesus came into my heart;
And my sins which were many
Are all washed away,
Since Jesus came into my heart.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
There's a light in the
Valley of death now for me,
Since Jesus came into my heart;
And the gates of the city
Beyond I can see,
Since Jesus came into my heart.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
I shall go there to dwell
In that city I know,
Since Jesus came into my heart;
And I'm happy, so happy,
As onward I go,
Since Jesus came into my heart.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
I'm possessed of a hope
That is steadfast and sure,
Since Jesus came into my heart;
And no dark clouds of doubt
Now my pathway obscure,
Since Jesus came into my heart.

title: Sing Praise To God Who Reigns Above
artist: Frances E. Cox, Johann J. Schutz

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Sing praise to God who reigns above,
The God of all creation;
The God of pow'r the God of love,
The God of our salvation.
With healing balm my soul He fills,
And ev'ry faithless murmur still;
To God, all praise and glory.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
What God's almighty pow'r hath made,
His gracious mercy keepeth;
By morning glow or evening shade,
His watchful eye ne'er sleepeth.
Within the kingdom of His might,
Lo, all is just and all is right;
To God, all praise and glory.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
The Lord is never far away,
But, thru all grief distressing,
And everpresent help and stay,
Our peace and joy and blessing.
As with a mother's tender hand,
He leads His own, His chosen band,
To God, all praise and glory.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Thus all my toilsome way along,
I sing aloud His praises;
That men may hear the grateful song.
My voice unwearied raises,
Be joyful in the Lord my heart;
Both soul and body bear your part,
To God all praise and glory.

title: Singing I Go
artist: Eliza E. Hewitt, William J. Kirkpatrick

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Singing I go along life's road,
Praising the Lord, praising the Lord;
Singing I go along life's road,
For Jesus has lifted my load.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
The trusting heart to Jesus clings,
Nor any ill forebodes,
But at the cross of Calvary sings,
"Praise God for lifted loads!"

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
The passing days bring many cares.
"Fear not," I hear Him say;
And when my fears are turned to prayers,
The burdens slip away.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
He tells me of my Father's love,
And never slumbering eye;
My everlasting King above
Will all my needs supply.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
When to the throne of grace I flee,
I find the promise true;
The mighty arms upholding me
Will bear my burdens too.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Come home, come home.
Ye who are weary, come home.
Earnestly, tenderly Jesus is calling,
Calling, "O sinner, come home!"

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Softly and tenderly Jesus is calling,
Calling for you and for me.
See, on the portals,
He's waiting and watching,
Watching for you and for me.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Why should we tarry
When Jesus is pleading,
Pleading for you and for me?
Why should we linger
And heed not His mercies,
Mercies for you and for me?

sections.label: Verse 3
Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Oh for the wonderful
Love He has promised,
Promised for you and for me!
Though we have sinned,
He has mercy and pardon,
Pardon for you and for me.

title: Stand Up And Bless The Lord

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Stand up and bless the Lord your God
Ye people of God's choice;
Stand up and bless the Lord your God
With heart and soul and voice.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Though high above all praise,
Above all blessing high,
Who would not fear His holy name,
And laud and magnify?

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
O for the living flame
From God's own altar brought,
To touch our lips, our minds inspire,
And wing to heaven our thought!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
God is our strength and song,
Now is salvation ours;
Then be God's love in Christ proclaimed
With all our ransomed powers.

sections.label: Verse 5

title: Star Spangled Banner
artist: Francis Scott Key, John Stafford Smith

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Oh, say, can you see,
By the dawn's early light,
What so proudly we hailed
At the twilight's last gleaming?
Whose broad stripes and bright stars,
Thro' the perilous fight,
O'er the ramparts we watched,
Were so gallantly streaming?
And the rocket's red glare,
The bombs bursting in air,
Gave proof thro' the night,
That our flag was still there.
Oh, say, does that star-spangled
Banner yet wave
O'er the land of the free,
And the home of the brave?

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Oh, thus be it ever,
When freemen shall stand
Between their loved homes,
And the war's desolation;
Blest with vict'ry and peace,
May the heav'n rescued land
Praise the Pow'r that hath made.
And preserved us a nation!
Then conquer we must,
When our cause it is just;
And this be our motto:
"In God is our trust!"
And the star-spangled banner
In triumph shall wave
O'er the land of the free,
And the home of the brave.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
On the shore, dimly seen
Thro' the mists of the deep,
Where the foe's haughty host
In dread silence reposes,
What is that which the breeze,
O'er the towering steep,
As it fitfully blows,
Half conceals, half discloses?
Now it catches the gleam
Of the morning's first beam,
In full glory reflected,
Now shines on the stream:
'Tis the star-spangled banner;
Oh, long may it wave
O'er the land of the free,
And the home of the brave.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
And where is that band,
Who so vauntingly swore
That the havoc of war
And the battle's confusion,
A home and a country
Should leave us no more?
Their blood has washed out
Their foul footsteps' pollution;
No refuge could save
The hireling and slave
From the terror of flight
Or the gloom of the grave.
And the star-spangled banner
In triumph shall wave
O'er the land of the free,
And the home of the brave.

title: Sunlight Sunlight
artist: Judson Van DeVenter, Winfield S. Weeden

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Sunlight, sunlight in my soul today!
Sunlight, sunlight all along the way!
Since the Savior found me,
Took away my sin,
I have had the sunlight of His love within.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I wandered in the shades of night
Till Jesus came to me,
And with the sunlight of His love
Bid all my darkness flee.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Tho clouds may gather in the sky,
And billows round me roll,
However dark the world may be,
I've sunlight in my soul,

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
While walking in the light of God,
I sweet communion find;
I press with holy vigor on,
And leave the world behind.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
I cross the wide extended fields,
I journey o'er the plain,
And in the sunlight of His love
I reap the golden grain.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Soon I shall see Him as He is,
The light that came to me;
Behold the brightness of His face
Thro'out eternity.

title: Sunshine In My Soul
artist: Eliza E. Hewitt, John R. Sweney

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
O there's sunshine, blessed sunshine,
When the peaceful happy moments roll.
When Jesus shows His smiling face,
There is sunshine in my soul.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
There is sunshine in my soul today,
More glorious and bright
Than glows in any earthly sky,
For Jesus is my light.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
There is music in my soul today,
A carol to my King;
And Jesus, listening can hear
The songs I cannot sing.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
There is springtime in my soul today,
For when the Lord is near
The dove of peace sings in my heart,
The flow'rs of grace appear.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
There is gladness in my soul today,
And hope and praise and love,
For blessings which He gives me now,
For joys "laid up" above.

title: Sweet Hour Of Prayer
artist: William B. Bradbury, William W. Walford

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Sweet hour of prayer,
Sweet hour of prayer,
That calls me from a world of care
And bids me at my Father's throne
Make all my wants and wishes known.
In seasons of distress and grief
My soul has often found relief,
And oft escaped the tempter's snare,
By Thy return sweet hour of prayer.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Sweet hour of prayer,
Sweet hour of prayer.
The joys I feel, the bliss I share.
Of those whose anxious spirits burn
With strong desires for Thy return.
With such I hasten to the place
Where God, my Savior, shows His face.
And gladly take my station there,
And wait for Thee, sweet hour of prayer.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Sweet hour of prayer,
Sweet hour of prayer,
Thy wings shall my petition bear
To Him whose truth and faithfulness
Engage the waiting soul to bless;
And since He bids me seek His face,
Believe His word, and trust His grace,
I'll cast on Him my ev'ry care.
And wait for Thee, sweet hour of prayer.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Sweet hour of prayer,
Sweet hour of prayer,
May I Thy consolation share,
'Til from Mount Pisgah's lofty height,
I view my home and take my flight.
This robe of flesh
I'll drop and rise
To seize the everlasting prize,
And shout while passing through the air,
Farewell, farewell sweet hour of prayer.

title: Take My Life And Let It Be

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Take my life, and let it be
Consecrated, Lord, to Thee;
Take my moments and my days,
Let them flow with ceaseless praise.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Take my hands, and let them move
At the impulse of Thy love;
Take my feet, and let them be
Swift and beautiful for Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Take my voice, and let me sing
Always, only, for my King;
Take my lips, and let them be
Filled with messages from Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Take my silver and my gold,
Not a mite would I withhold;
Take my intellect, and use
Every power as Thou shalt choose.

sections.label: Verse 5
Verse 6
sections.lyrics:
Take my love; my Lord, I pour
At Thy feet its treasure store:
Take myself, and I will be
Ever, only, all for Thee.

title: Take The Name Of Jesus With You

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Precious name, O how sweet!
Hope of earth and joy of heaven.
Precious name, O how sweet!
Hope of earth and joy of heaven.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Take the name of Jesus with you.
Child of sorrow and of woe.
It will joy and comfort give you;
Take it then where'er you go.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Take the name of Jesus ever,
As a shield from every snare.
If temptations round you gather,
Breathe that holy name in prayer.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
O the precious name of Jesus!
How it thrills our souls with joy.
When His loving arms receive us
And His songs our tongues employ!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
At the name of Jesus bowing,
Falling prostrate at His feet.
King of kings in heaven we'll crown Him,
When our journey is complete.

title: Take Time To Be Holy
artist: George C. Stebbins, William D. Longstaff

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Take time to be holy.
Speak oft with thy Lord;
Abide in Him always,
And feed on His Word.
Make friends with God's children;
Help those who are weak,
Forgetting in nothing
His blessing to seek.

sections.label: Verse 2
