sections.lyrics:
Take time to be holy.
The world rushes on;
Spend much time in secret
With Jesus alone.
By looking to Jesus,
Like Him thou shalt be;
Thy friends in thy conduct
His likeness shall see.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Take time to be holy.
Let Him be thy Guide;
And run not before Him,
Whatever betide.
In joy or in sorrow,
Still follow thy Lord,
And, looking to Jesus,
Still trust in His word.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Take time to be holy,
Be calm in thy soul;
Each thought and each motive
Beneath His control;
Thus led by His Spirit
To fountains of love,
Thou soon shalt be fitted
For service above.

title: Tell It To Jesus
artist: Edmund S. Lorenz, Jeremiah E. Rankin

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Tell it to Jesus,
Tell it to Jesus.
He is a Friend that's well known.
You have no other
Such a friend or brother.
Tell it to Jesus alone.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Are you weary,
Are you heavy hearted?
Tell it to Jesus,
Tell it to Jesus.
Are you grieving
Over joys departed?
Tell it to Jesus alone.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Do the tears flow down
Your cheeks unbidden?
Tell it to Jesus,
Tell it to Jesus.
Have you sins that
To men's eyes are hidden?
Tell it to Jesus alone.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Do you fear the
Gathering clouds of sorrow?
Tell it to Jesus,
Tell it to Jesus.
Are you anxious
What shall be tomorrow?
Tell it to Jesus alone.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Are you troubled
At the thought of dying?
Tell it to Jesus,
Tell it to Jesus.
For Christ's coming kingdom
Are you sighing?
Tell it to Jesus alone.

title: Tell Me The Story Of Jesus

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
... all the rich treasures of wisdom, unto my soul impart.
Tell me the beautiful story, the wonderful, wonderful
Story; tell me the beautiful story of Jesus and His love.
Tell me the story of Jesus, tell of His wondrous love; tell
Of His mercy to sinners, tell of the home above.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Tell the blessed story, of the cross of Jesus.
Tell the blessed story, of the hallowed cross.
Until every nation, learns of full salvation.
Tell the blessed story of the cross.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Church of God awaken, heed the Lord's command.
Tell the blessed story of the cross.
Fields are white for harvesting, on ev'ry hand.
Tell the blessed story of the cross.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Has He not commissioned you, the news to bear.
Tell the blessed story of the cross.
Go ye into all the world, and ev'rywhere
Tell the blessed story of the cross.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Stand no longer idle, while the moments fly.
Tell the blessed story of the cross.
Multitudes in heathen darkness live and die.
Tell the blessed story of the cross.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Publish unto all the world redeeming grace.
Tell the blessed story of the cross.
Until in the home of rest you find your place,
Tell the blessed story of the cross.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
That beautiful name! That beautiful name
From sin has power to free us!
That beautiful name! That wonderful name!
That matchless name is Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I know of a name, a beautiful name
That angels brought down to earth.
They whispered it low,
One night long ago
To a maiden of lowly birth.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
I know of a name, a beautiful name
That unto a babe was given.
The stars glittered bright
Throughout that glad nigh,
And angels praised God in heaven.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
The One of that name, my Savior became
My Savior of Calvary.
My sins nailed Him there,
My burdens He bare.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
I love that blest name
Made higher than all in heaven.
'Twas whispered, I know,
In my heart long ago.
To Jesus my life I've given.

title: The Advent Of Our God
artist: Aaron Williams, Charles Coffin, John Chandler

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
The advent of our God,
With eager hearts we greet;
And we must praise Him in this hour,
With hymns and anthems sweet.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
All glory to the Son,
Who comes to set us free;
With Father, Spirit ever One,
Through all eternity.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
The everlasting Son,
Incarnate stoops to be;
Himself the servant's form
Puts on to set his people free.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Come, Zion's daughter,
Rise to meet your lowly King;
Nor let your faithless heart despise
The peace He comes to bring.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
As judge, on clouds of light,
He soon will come again;
And all His scattered saints
Unite with Him on high to reign.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.lyrics:
Before the dawning day
Let sin be put to flight;
No longer let the law hold sway,
But walk in freedom's light.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
The Bible stands tho' the hills may tumble,
It will firmly stand when the earth shall crumble.
I will plant my feet on its firm foundation,
For the Bible stands, the Bible stands.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
The Bible stands like a rock undaunted,
Mid the raging storms of time.
Its pages burn with the truth eternal,
And they glow with a light sublime.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
The Bible stands like a mountain towering,
Far above the works of man.
Its truth by none ever was refuted,
And destroy it they never can.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
The Bible stands, and it will forever,
When the world has passed away.
By inspiration it has been given,
All its precepts I will obey.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
The Bible stands every test we give it,
For its Author is divine.
By grace alone I expect to live it,
And to prove it and make it mine.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Alleluia! O how the angels sang!
Alleluia! How it rang!
And the sky was bright with a holy light,
'Twas the birthday of a King.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
In the little village of Bethlehem,
There lay a Child one day;
And the sky was bright with a holy light,
O'er the place where Jesus lay.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
'Twas a humble birthplace,
But oh, how much God gave to us that day;
From the manger bed what a path has led,
What a perfect holy way.

sections.label: Ending
sections.lyrics:
O come, let us adore Him;
O come, let us adore Him,
Christ, the Lord.
'Twas the birthday of a Savior.
Alleluia! Alleluia!
'Twas the birthday of a King.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Noel, Noel, Noel, Noel,
Born is the King of Israel.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
The first Noel,
The angel did say,
Was to certain poor shepherds,
In fields as they lay;
In fields where they
Lay keeping their sheep,
On a cold winter's night
That was so deep.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
They looked up and saw a star
Shining in the east,
Beyond them far,
And to the earth
It gave great light,
And so it continued
Both day and night.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
And by the light
Of that same star,
Three wise men came
From country far;
To seek for a King
Was their intent,
And to follow the star,
Wherever it went.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
This star drew nigh
To the northwest,
O'er Bethlehem
It took its rest,
And there it did
Both stop and stay,
Right over the place
Where Jesus lay.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Then entered in
Those wise men three,
Full rev'rently
Upon their knee,
And offered there
In His presence,
Their gold, and myrrh,
And frankincense.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.lyrics:
Then let us all
With one accord,
Sing praises to
Our heavenly Lord,
That hath made heav'n
And earth of naught,
And with His blood
Mankind hath bought.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
The God of Abraham praise,
Who reigns enthroned above;
Ancient of everlasting days,
And God of love.
Jehovah, great I Am,
By earth and heaven confessed;
I bow and bless the sacred name,
Forevermore blest.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
The God of Abraham praise,
At whose supreme command;
From earth I rise,
And seek the joys
At His right hand.
I all on earth forsake,
Its wisdom, fame, and power;
And Him my only portion make,
My shield and tower.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
He by Himself hath sworn,
I on His oath depend;
I shall on eagles wings upborne,
To heaven ascend.
I shall behold His face,
I shall His power adore;
And sing the wonders
Of His grace forevermore.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
The whole triumphant host,
Give thanks to God on high;
"Hail, Father, Son and Holy Ghost!"
They ever cry.
Hail, Abraham's God and mine!
I join the heavenly lays,
All might and majesty are Thine;
And endless praise.
Amen.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Oh I'm trav'ling on the hallelujah line,
On the good old gospel train.
I am on the right track,
And never will go back
To the station of sin again.
I am trav'ling on the hallelujah line,
On the good old gospel train.
I need no fare, I'm riding on a pass,
'Tis the blood for sinners slain.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Sweetest note in seraph song,
Sweetest name on mortal tongue,
Sweetest carol ever sung,
Jesus, blessed Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
The great Physician now is near,
The sympathizing Jesus.
He speaks the drooping heart to cheer.
O hear the voice of Jesus!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Your many sins are all forgiven,
O hear the voice of Jesus!
Go on your way,
In peace to heaven,
And wear a crown with Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
All glory to the dying Lamb,
I now believe in Jesus.
I love the blessed Savior's name;
I love the name of Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
And when to that bright world above
We rise to be with Jesus,
We'll sing around the throne of love
His name, the name of Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
His name dispels my guilt and fear,
No other name but Jesus;
O how my soul delights to hear
The precious name of Jesus.

title: The King Of Love
artist: Henry Williams Baker, John Bacchus Dykes

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
The King of love my Shepherd is,
Whose goodness faileth never;
I nothing lack if I am His,
And He is mine forever.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Where streams of living water flow
My ransomed soul He leadeth;
And where the verdant pastures grow,
With food celestial feedeth.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Perverse and foolish oft I strayed
But yet in love He sought me.
And on His shoulder gently laid,
And home rejoicing brought me.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
In death's dark vale I fear no ill
With Thee, dear Lord beside me;
Thy rod and staff my comfort still,
Thy cross before to guide me.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
And so through all the length of days,
Thy goodness faileth never.
Good Shepherd, may I sing Thy praise,
Within Thy house forever.

title: The Lord's My Shepherd
artist: Francis Rous, Jessie Seymour Irvine, William Mure

sections.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
My soul He doth restore again,
And me to walk doth make;
Within the paths of righteousness,
E'en for His own name's sake.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Yea, tho' I walk in death's dark vale,
Yet will I fear no ill for Thou art with me
And Thy rod and staff me comfort still.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
My table Thou hast furnished
In presence of my foes;
My head Thou dost with oil anoint,
And my cup overflows.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Goodness and mercy all my life
Shall surely follow me,
And in God's house forevermore
My dwelling place shall be.
Amen.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
O love of God, how rich and pure!
How measureless and strong!
It shall forevermore endure,
The saints' and angels' song.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
The love of God is greater far,
Than tongue or pen can ever tell,
It goes beyond the highest star
And reaches to the lowest hell;
The guilty pair, bowed down with care,
God gave His Son to win;
His erring child He reconciled
And pardoned from his sin.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
When years of time shall pass away
And earthly thrones and kingdoms fall,
When men, who here refuse to pray,
On rocks and hills and mountains call;
God's love so sure shall still endure,
All measureless and strong;
Redeeming grace to Adam's race
The saints' and angels' song.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Could we with ink the ocean fill
And were the skies of parchment made,
Were ev'ry stalk on earth a quill
And ev'ry man a scribe by trade.
To write the love of God above
Would drain the ocean dry;
Nor could the scroll contain the whole
Tho stretched from sky to sky.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
"Jesus," O how sweet the name!
"Jesus," every day the same!
"Jesus," let all saints proclaim
Its worthy praise forever!

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
The name of Jesus is so sweet,
I love its music to repeat.
It makes my joys full and complete,
The precious name of Jesus!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
I love the name of Him whose heart,
Knows all my griefs and bears a part,
Who bids all anxious fears depart,
I love the name of Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 3
Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
No word of man can ever tell
How sweet the name I love so well.
O let its praises ever swell!
O praise the name of Jesus!

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
So I'll cherish the old rugged cross,
Till my trophies at last I lay down;
I will cling to the old rugged cross,
And exchange it some day for a crown.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
On a hill far away
Stood an old rugged cross;
The emblem of suffering and shame.
And I love that old cross
Where the dearest and best,
For a world of lost sinners was slain.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Oh, that old rugged cross,
So despised by the world,
Has a wondrous attraction for me;
For the dear Lamb of God,
Left His glory above,
To bear it to dark Calvary.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
In the old rugged cross,
Stained with blood so divine,
A wondrous beauty I see;
For 'twas on that old cross,
Jesus suffered and died,
To pardon and sanctify me.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
To the old rugged cross
I will ever be true,
It's shame and reproach gladly bear;
Then He'll call me some day
To my home far away,
Where His glory forever I'll share.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
On Christ the solid Rock I stand,
All other ground is sinking sand.
All other ground is sinking sand.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
My hope is built on nothing less
Than Jesus' blood and righteousness.
I dare not trust the sweetest frame,
But wholly lean on Jesus' name.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
When darkness seems to hide His face,
I rest on His unchanging grace.
In every high and stormy gale,
My anchor holds within the veil.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
His oath, His covenant, His blood,
Support me in the whelming flood.
When all around my soul gives way,
He then is all my Hope and Stay.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
When He shall come with trumpet sound,
O may I then in Him be found!
Dressed in His righteousness alone,
Faultless to stand before the throne!

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
The spacious firmament on high,
With all the blue ethereal sky
And spangled heav'ns a shining frame;
Their great original proclaim.
Th'unwearied sun from day to day,
Does His Creator's pow'r display
And publishes to every land,
The work of an Almighty hand.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Soon as the evening shades prevail,
The moon takes up the wondrous tale
And nightly to the listening earth,
Repeats the story of her birth;
While all the stars that round her burn
And all the planets in their turn
Confirm the tidings as they roll,
And spread the truth from pole to pole.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
What though in solemn silence all,
Move round the dark terrestrial ball?
What though no real voice nor sound,
Amid their radiant orbs be found;
In reason's ear they all rejoice
And utter forth a glorious voice;
Forever singing as they shine,
The hand that made us is divine.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
O, behold the Man of sorrows!
O, behold Him in plain view!
Lo! He is the mighty conqu'ror
Since He rent the veil in two.
Lo! He is the mighty conqu'ror
Since He rent the veil in two.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Once our blessed Christ of beauty
Was veiled off from human view;
But thro' suff'ring, death, and sorrow
He has rent the veil in two.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Yes, He is with God, the Father,
Interceding there for you;
For He is the mighty conqu'ror
Since He rent the veil in two.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Holy angels bow before Him,
Men of earth give praises due;
For He is the well beloved,
Since He rent the veil in two.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Thro'out time and endless ages,
Heights and depths of love so true,
He alone can be the giver,
Since He rent the veil in two.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
There is a fountain filled with blood
Drawn from Immanuel's veins;
And sinners, plunged beneath that flood,
Lose all their guilty stains:
Lose all their guilty stains,
Lose all their guilty stains;
And sinners, plunged beneath that flood,
Lose all their guilty stains.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
The dying thief rejoiced to see
That fountain in his day;
And there may I, though vile as he,
Wash all my sins away:
Wash all my sins away,
Wash all my sins away;
And there may I, though vile as he,
Wash all my sins away.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Dear dying Lamb, Thy precious blood
Shall never lose its power
Till all the ransomed church of God
Are saved, to sin no more:
Are saved, to sin no more,
Are saved, to sin no more;
Till all the ransomed church of God
Are saved, to sin no more.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
For since by faith I saw the stream
Thy flowing wounds supply,
Redeeming love has been my theme,
And shall be till I die:
And shall be till I die,
And shall be till I die;
Redeeming love has been my theme
And shall be till I die.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
When this poor lisping, stamm'ring tongue
Lies silent in the grave,
Then in a nobler, sweeter song
I'll sing Thy pow'r to save:
Then in a nobler sweeter song
I'll sing Thy pow'r to save;
I'll sing Thy pow'r to save,
I'll sing Thy pow'r to save;
Then in a nobler sweeter song
I'll sing Thy pow'r to save.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.lyrics:
E'er since by faith I saw the stream
Thy flowing wounds supply,
Redeeming love has been my theme,
And shall be till I die:
And shall be till I die,
And shall be till I die;
Redeeming love has been my theme,
And shall be till I die.

title: There Is No Name So Sweet On Earth
artist: George W. Bethune, William B. Bradbury

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
We love to sing of Christ our King
And hail Him blessed Jesus;
For there's no word ear ever heard,
So dear, so sweet as Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
There is no name so sweet on earth,
No name so sweet in heaven;
The name before His wondrous birth,
To Christ the Savior given.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
And when He hung upon the tree,
They wrote this name above Him;
That all might see the reason we,
For evermore must love Him.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
So now upon His Father's throne,
Almighty to release us;
From sin and pain He ever reigns,
The Prince and Savior Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
O Jesus, by that matchless name,
Thy grace shall fail us never;
Today as yesterday the same,
Thou art the same forever.

title: There's A Wideness In God's Mercy
artist: Frederick W. Faber, Lizzie S. Tourjee

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
There's a wideness in God's mercy
Like the wideness of the sea;
There's a kindness in His justice,
Which is more than liberty.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
There is welcome for the sinner,
And more graces for the good.
There is mercy with the Savior;
There is healing in His blood.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
For the love of God is broader
Than the measure of man's mind;
And the heart of the Eternal
Is most wonderfully kind.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
If our love were but more simple,
We should take Him at His word;
And our lives would be all sunshine
In the sweetness of our Lord.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
There is plentiful redemption
In the blood that has been shed;
There is joy for all the members
In the sorrows of the Head.

title: This Is My Father's World
artist: Franklin Lawrence Sheppard, Maltbie Davenport Babcock

sections.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
This is my Father's world,
O let me ne'er forget
That though the wrong seems oft so strong,
God is the Ruler yet.
This is my Father's world;
The battle is not done;
Jesus, who died, shall be satisfied,
And earth and heaven be one.

title: Thou Didst Leave Thy Throne
artist: Emily E.S. Elliott, Timothy Richard Matthews

sections.label: Chorus 1
sections.lyrics:
O come to my heart, Lord Jesus.
There is room in my heart for Thee.

sections.label: Chorus 2
sections.lyrics:
My heart shall rejoice, Lord Jesus,
When Thou comest and callest for me.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Thou didst leave Thy throne
And Thy kingly crown,
When Thou camest to earth for me.
But in Bethlehem's home
Was there found no room
For Thy holy nativity.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Heaven's arches rang,
When the angels sang,
Proclaiming Thy royal decree;
But of lowly birth,
Didst Thou come to earth
And in great humility.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
The foxes found rest
And the birds their nest,
In the shade of the forest tree;
But Thy couch was the sod,
O Thou Son of God,
In the deserts of Galilee.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Thou camest, O Lord,
With the living word,
That should set Thy people free;
But with mocking scorn
And with crown of thorn,
They bore Thee to Calvary.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
When the heaven's shall ring
And the angels sing,
At Thy coming to victory;
Let Thy voice call me home,
Saying, "Yet there is room,
There is room at My side for thee."

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Wonderful, wonderful,
Marvelous and wonderful
What He has done for my soul!
The half has never been told
Oh, it is wonderful.
It is marvelous and wonderful
What Jesus has done for this soul of mine!
The half has never been told.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
The Savior has come in His mighty power,
And spoken peace to my soul.
And all of my life from that very hour,
I've yielded to His control.
I've yielded to His control.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
'Twas only a foretaste of joys divine
In Canaan waiting for me;
Where sweetest honey and milk and wine
Were dripping from ev'ry tree
Were dripping from ev'ry tree.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
From glory to glory He leads me on
From grace to grace ev'ry day;
And brighter and brighter the glory dawns
While pressing my homeward way
While pressing my homeward way.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
If fellowship here with my Lord can be
So inexpressibly sweet
Oh, what will it be when His face we see
When 'round the white throne we meet.
When 'round the white throne we meet.

title: Tis So Sweet To Trust In Jesus

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Jesus, Jesus how I trust Him!
How I've proved Him o'er and o'er!
Jesus, Jesus, precious Jesus!
O for grace to trust Him more!

sections.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
O how sweet to trust in Jesus,
Just to trust His cleansing blood;
Just in simple faith to plunge me,
Neath the healing, cleansing flood!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Yes, 'tis sweet to trust in Jesus,
Just from sin and self to cease;
Just from Jesus simply taking
Life and rest and joy and peace.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
I'm so glad I learned to trust Thee,
Precious Jesus, Savior friend;
And I know that Thou art with me,
Wilt be with me to the end.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Praise the Lord! Praise the Lord!
Let the earth hear His voice!
Praise the Lord! Praise the Lord!
Let the people rejoice!
O come to the Father
Through Jesus the Son;
And give Him the glory,
Great things He hath done!

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
To God be the glory!
Great things He hath done!
So lov'd He the world
That He gave us His Son,
Who yielded His life
An atonement for sin,
And open'd the lifegate
That all may go in.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
O perfect redemption, the purchase of blood!
To every believer the promise of God;
The vilest offender who truly believes,
That moment from Jesus a pardon receives.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Great things He hath taught us,
Great things He hath done,
And great our rejoicing through Jesus the Son:
But purer and higher and greater will be
Our wonder, our worship, when Jesus we see!

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
'Twas a glad day when Jesus found me.
When His strong arms were thrown around me,
When my sins He buried in the deepest sea,
And my soul He filled with joy and victory.
'Twas a glad day, O hallelujah.
'Twas a glad day He claimed His own.
I will shout a glad hosanna in glory,
When I see Him upon His throne.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I was lost in sin when Jesus found me.
But He rescued me, all glory to His name.
And the cords of worldly pleasure bound me,
'Til He saved me from sin and shame.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Oh, the bells of heaven now are ringing,
For I hear their tones within my ransomed soul.
And my heart is filled with joyful singing,
Since the Savior hath made me whole.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Oh, the joy when we shall meet in glory,
In the mansions of my Father's home above.
And through endless ages tell the story,
Of the Savior's redeeming love.

title: We Praise Thee O God Our Redeemer
artist: A. Valerius, Julia Bulkley Cady Cory

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
We praise Thee, O God,
Our Redeemer, Creator
In grateful devotion
Our tribute we bring;
We lay it before Thee,
We kneel and adore Thee,
We bless Thy holy name,
Glad praises we sing.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
We worship Thee,
God of our fathers,
We bless Thee
Thru life's storm and tempest,
Our guide has Thou been;
When perils o'er take us,
Escape Thou wilt make us,
And with Thy help, O Lord,
Our battles we win.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
With voices united
Our praises we offer
To Thee, great Jehovah,
Glad anthems we raise;
Thy strong arm will guide us,
Our God is beside us,
To Thee, our great Redeemer,
Forever be praise!

title: We Three Kings Of Orient Are

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
O star of wonder, star of night,
Star with royal beauty bright;
Westward leading, still proceeding,
Guide us to Thy perfect light.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
We three kings of Orient are,
Bearing gifts we traverse afar;
Field and fountain moor and mountain,
Following yonder star.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Born a King on Bethlehem's plain,
Gold I bring to crown Him again;
King forever, ceasing never,
Over us all to reign.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Frankincense to offer have I,
Incense owns a Deity nigh;
Prayer and praising, all men raising,
Worship Him, God on high.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Myrrh is mine, its bitter perfume,
Breathes a life of gathering gloom;
Sorrowing, sighing, bleeding, dying,
Sealed in the stone cold tomb.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Glorious now behold Him arise,
King and God and sacrifice;
Alleluia, alleluia!
Earth to heav'n replies.

title: What A Friend We Have In Jesus
artist: Charles C. Converse, Joseph M. Scriven

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
What a Friend we have in Jesus,
All our sins and griefs to bear!
What a privilege to carry,
Everything to God in prayer!
Oh, what peace we often forfeit,
Oh, what needless pain we bear.
All because we do not carry
Everything to God in prayer!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Have we trials and temptations?
Is there trouble anywhere?
We should never be discouraged;
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Can we find a friend so faithful,
Who will all our sorrows share?
Jesus knows our every weakness;
Take it to the Lord in prayer.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Are we weak and heavy laden,
Cumbered with a load of care?
Precious Savior, still our refuge!
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Do Thy friends despise forsake Thee?
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
In His arms He'll take and shield Thee;
Thou wilt find a solace there.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
What a wonderful Savior,
Is Jesus my Jesus!
What a wonderful Savior,
Is Jesus my Lord!

sections.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4
Verse 5
Verse 6

title: What Child Is This
artist: Pietro A. Yon, William C. Dix

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
This, this is Christ the King,
Whom shepherds guard and angels sing.
Haste, haste to bring Him laud,
The Babe, the Son of Mary.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
What child is this who,
Laid to rest,
On Mary's lap is sleeping?
Whom angels greet with anthems sweet,
While shepherds watch are keeping.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Why lies He in such mean estate
Where ox and ass are feeding?
Good Christian, fear;
For sinners here
The silent Word is pleading.

sections.label: Verse 3
Chorus
sections.lyrics:
But God hath promised strength for the day,
Rest for the labor, light for the way,
Grace for the trials, help from above,
Unfailing sympathy, undying love.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
God hath not promised skies always blue,
Flower strewn pathways all our lives through.
God hath not promised sun without rain,
Joy without sorrow, peace without pain.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
God hath not promised we shall not know
Toil and temptation, trouble and woe.
He hath not told us we shall not bear
Many a burden many a care.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
God hath not promised smooth roads and wide,
Swift, easy, travel needing no guide,
Never a mountain, rocky and steep,
Never a river, turbid and deep.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
What wondrous love is this,
O my soul, O my soul!
What wondrous love is this, O my soul!
What wondrous love is this
That caused the Lord of bliss
To bear the dreadful curse
For my soul, for my soul,
To bear the dreadful curse for my soul!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
When I was sinking down,
Sinking down, sinking down,
When I was sinking down, sinking down;
When I was sinking down
Beneath God's righteous frown,
Christ laid aside His crown
For my soul, for my soul,
Christ laid aside
His crown for my soul!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
To God and to the Lamb,
I will sing, I will sing,
To God and to the Lamb, I will sing!
To God and to the Lamb
Who is the "Great I Am"
While millions join the theme
I will sing, I will sing,
While millions join the theme
I will sing!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
And when from death I'm free,
I'll sing on, I'll sing on,
And when from death I'm free, I'll sing on!
And when from death I'm free,
I'll sing and joyful be
And through eternity
I'll sing on, I'll sing on
And thro' eternity, I'll sing on!

title: When I Survey The Wondrous Cross

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
When I survey the wondrous cross
On which the Prince of glory died,
My richest gain I count but loss,
And pour contempt on all my pride.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Forbid it, Lord, that I should boast,
Save in the death of Christ, my God;
All the vain things that charm me most,
I sacrifice them to His blood.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
See, from His head, His hands, His feet,
Sorrow and love flow mingled down;
Did e'er such love and sorrow meet,
Or thorns compose so rich a crown?

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Were the whole realm of nature mine,
That were a present far too small;
Love so amazing, so divine,
Demands my soul, my life, my all.

sections.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
The night becomes as day,
When from the heart we say,
May Jesus Christ be praised!
The pow'rs of darkness fear
When this sweet chant they hear;
May Jesus Christ be praised!

sections.label: Verse 4
Verse 5
Verse 6
Verse 7
sections.lyrics:
Whene'er the sweet church bell
Peals over hill and dell
May Jesus Christ be praised!
O hark to what it sings,
As joyously it rings,
May Jesus Christ be praised!

title: When We All Get To Heaven
artist: Eliza E. Hewitt, Emily D. Wilson

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
When we all get to heaven,
What a day of rejoicing that will be!
When we all see Jesus,
We'll sing and shout the victory.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Sing the wondrous love of Jesus,
Sing His mercy and His grace;
In the mansions bright and blessed,
He'll prepare for us a place.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
While we walk the pilgrim pathway,
Clouds will overspread the sky;
But when traveling days are over,
Not a shadow, not a sigh.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Let us then be true and faithful,
Trusting, serving every day;
Just one glimpse of Him in glory
Will the toils of life repay.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Onward to the prize before us!
Soon His beauty we'll behold;
Soon the pearly gates will open,
We shall tread the streets of gold.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
While shepherds watched their flocks by night,
All seated on the ground,
The angel of the Lord came down,
And glory shone around.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
"Be not afraid," the angel said,
For fear had seized their mind;
"Glad tidings of great joy I bring
To you and all mankind.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
"To you, in David's town town this day
Is born of David's line
A Savior, who is Christ the Lord;
And this shall be the sign:

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
"The heavenly Babe you there shall find
To human view displayed,
In simple clothing, tightly wrapped,
And in a manger laid."

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Thus spoke the seraph, and at once
Appeared a shining throng
Of angels praising God, who thus
Addressed their joyful song:

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.lyrics:
"All glory be to God on high
And on the earth be peace;
Good will hence forth from heaven to men
Begin and never cease."

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Wonderful, the matchless grace of Jesus.
Deeper than the mighty rolling sea.
Higher than the mountains
Sparkling like a fountain,
All sufficient grace for even me.
Broader than the scope
Of my transgressions.
Greater far than all my sin and shame.
O, magnify the precious name of Jesus!
Praise His name!

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Wonderful grace of Jesus,
Greater than all my sin.
How shall my tongue describe it?
Where shall its praise begin?
Taking away my burden,
Setting my Spirit free.
For wonderful grace of Jesus reaches me.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Wonderful grace of Jesus,
Reaching to all the lost.
By it I have been pardoned,
Saved to the uttermost.
Chains have been torn asunder,
Giving me liberty.
For the wonderful grace
Of Jesus reaches me.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Wonderful grace of Jesus,
Reaching the most defiled.
By its transforming power
Making Him God's dear child.
Purchasing peace and heaven
For all eternity.
And the wonderful grace
Of Jesus reaches me.

title: Wonderful Peace
artist: W. George Cooper, Warren D. Cornell

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Peace, Peace, wonderful peace,
Coming down from the Father above.
Sweep over my spirit forever, I pray,
In fathomless billows of love.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Far away in the depths
Of my spirit tonight
Rolls a melody sweeter than psalm;
In celestial-like strains
It unceasingly falls
O'er my soul like an infinite calm.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
What a treasure I have
In this wonderful peace,
Buried deep in the heart of my soul,
So secure that no power can mine it away
While the years of eternity roll.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
I am resting tonight
In this wonderful peace,
Resting sweetly in Jesus' control.
For I'm kept from all danger
By night and by day,
And His glory is flooding my soul.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
And me-thinks when I rise
To that city of peace,
Where the Author of peace I shall see,
That one strain of the song
Which the ransomed will sing
In that heavenly kingdom shall be:

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Ah soul, are you here
Without comfort or rest,
Marching down the rough pathway of time?
Make Jesus your friend
Ere the shadows grow dark.
Oh accept this sweet peace so sublime.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Wonderful Savior, wonderful Savior,
Thou art so near, so precious to me!
Wonderful Savior, wonderful Savior
My heart is filled with praises to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Jesus, my King, my wonderful Savior,
All of my life is given to Thee.
I am rejoicing in Thy salvation.
Thy precious blood now maketh me free.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Freedom from sin, O wonderful story!
All of its stains washed whiter than snow!
Jesus has come to live in His temple,
And with His love my heart is aglow.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Jesus, my Lord, I'll ever adore Thee,
Lay at Thy feet my treasures of love.
Lead me in ways to show forth Thy glory,
Ways that will end in heaven above.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
When in that bright and beautiful city
I shall behold Thy glories untold,
I shall be like Thee, wonderful Savior,
And I will sing while ages unfold.

title: Ye Must Be Born Again
artist: George C. Stebbins, William T. Sleeper

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
"Ye must be born again;
Ye must be born again.
I verily, verily say unto thee,
Ye must be born again."

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
A ruler once came
To Jesus by night
To ask Him the way
Of salvation and light.
The Master made answer
In words true and plain,
"Ye must be born again."

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Ye children of men,
Attend to the word
So solemnly uttered
By Jesus, the Lord;
And let not this message
To you be in vain,
"Ye must be born again."

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
O ye who would enter
That glorious rest,
And sing with the ransomed
The song of the blest,
The life everlasting
If ye would obtain,
"Ye must be born again."

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
A dear one in heaven
Thy heart yearns to see,
At the beautiful gate
May be watching for thee;
Then list to the note
Of this solemn refrain,
"Ye must be born again."

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Ye servants of God, your Master proclaim,
And publish abroad His wonderful name;
The name all victorious, of Jesus extol,
His kingdom is glorious, He rules over all.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
God ruleth on high, almighty to save,
And still He is nigh, His presence we have;
The great congregation His triumph shall sing,
Ascribing salvation to Jesus our King.

sections.label: Verse 3
Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Then let us adore and give Him His right;
All glory and pow'r all wisdom and might.
All honor and blessing with angels above,
And thanks never ceasing and infinite love.
Amen.

title: Yesterday Today Forever
artist: Albert B. Simpson, James H. Burke

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Yesterday, today, forever,
Jesus is the same.
All may change but Jesus never!
Glory to His name!
Glory to His name!
Glory to His name!
All may change but Jesus never!
Glory to His name!

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Oh how sweet the glorious message
Simple faith may claim:
Yesterday, today, forever,
Jesus is the same!
Still He loves to save the sinful,
Heal the sick and lame,
Cheer the mourner,
Still the tempest.
Glory to His name!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
He who pardoned erring Peter,
Never need'st thou fear;
He that came to faithless Thomas
All thy doubt will clear.
He who let the loved disciple,
On His bosom rest
Bids thee still,
With love as tender,
Leaning upon His breast.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
He who mid the raging billows
Walked upon the sea
Still can hush our wildest tempest,
As on Galilee.
He who wept and prayed in anguish,
In Gethsemane,
Drinks with us each cup of trembling,
In our agony.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
As of old He walked to Emmaus,
With them to abide,
So through all life's way He walketh,
Ever near our side.
Soon again shall we behold Him.
Hasten, Lord, the day!
But 'twill still be "this same Jesus,"
As He went away.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
He who was the friend of sinners,
Seeks thee, lost one, now;
Sinner, come and at His footstool
Penitently bow.
He who said, "I'll not condemn thee,
Go and sin no more;"
Speaks to thee that word of pardon,
as in days of yore.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.lyrics:
Oft on earth He healed the suff'rer
By His mighty hand;
Still our sicknesses and sorrows
Go at His command.
He who gave His healing virtue,
To a woman's touch;
To the faith that claims His fullness,
Still will give as much.

title: You May Have The Joy Bells
artist: J. Edward Ruark, William J. Kirkpatrick

sections.label: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Joy bells ringing in your heart!
Joy bells ringing in your heart!
Take the Savior here below
With you ev'rywhere you go;
He will keep the joy bells
Ringing in your heart.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
You may have the joy bells
Ringing in your heart,
And a peace that
From You never will depart.
Walk the straight and narrow way;
Live for Jesus ev'ry day.
He will keep the joy bells
Ringing in your heart.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Love of Jesus in its fullness
You may know,
And this love to those around
You sweetly show.
Words of kindness always say;
Deeds of mercy do each day,
Then He'll keep the joy bells
Ringing in your heart.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
You will meet with trials
As you journey home;
Grace sufficent He will give to overcome.
Tho' unseen by mortal eye,
He is with you evernigh,
And He'll keep the joy bells
Ringing in your heart.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Let your life speak well
Of Jesus ev'ry day;
Own His right to ev'ry service
You can pay.
Sinners you can help to win
If your life is pure and clean,
And you keep the joy bells
Ringing in your heart.
